nodes.label: FMU2cs_crane (double-pendulum crane, FMI 2.0 co-simulation FMU)
nodes.rationale: Unlike the actuator FMU, the crane FMU can embed Irrlicht visualization; when Irrlicht is enabled on Windows the Irrlicht DLL is added to COMPONENT_DLL_DEPENDENCIES so it is packaged inside the .fmu binaries folder and the FMU stays self-contained for an external importer.
